text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega has starting training nonstop once again, despite my warnings. During one such session, she feels a sharp pain in her left leg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she's been expecting this to happen, based on a reoccurring nightmare she's been suffering in the lead up to the Kikuka Sho. But she doesn't care what happens to her, so long as she can complete her atonement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, when Admire Vega loses consciousness, she comes face-to-face with her sister, who tells her that she never did anything wrong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her sister says with a smile, "I was happy to be able to race together," before embracing the tragic fate meant for Admire Vega and disappearing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega finally hears my frantic calling and wakes up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She clings onto me and begins crying—with half of herself now gone, she feels lonely and empty.
